## Clubnek (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 N Medium magical beast  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +7  

**Defense**

 **AC** 14, touch 11, flat-footed 13 (+1 Dex, +3 natural)  
 **hp** 33 (3d10+3)  
 **Fort** +4; **Ref** +4; **Will** +1  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** beak +5 (1d4+2), 2 claws +5 (1d4+2)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 13, **Con** 12, **Int** 2, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 6  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 16  
 **Feats** Run, Skill Focus (Perception)  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +5 (+9 jumping), Perception +7, Stealth +5  
 **SQ** burst of speed  

**Special Abilities**

 **Burst of Speed (Ex)** Once every 5 rounds, a clubnek can move five times its normal speed (200 feet) when it makes a charge.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate forests  
 **Organization** flock (2–8)  
 **Treasure** none
